title: OnePlus rescheduled its upcoming smartphone event because Apple just recently announced its own event on the same day (AAPL)
text: OnePlus rescheduled its upcoming smartphone event because Apple just recently announced its own event on the same day (AAPL) By Antonio Villas-Boas Oct 19, 2018, 8:00 pm 114 pts OnePlus rescheduled its OnePlus 6T smartphone announcement event because Apple recently announced it's hosting an event on the same day. OnePlus' launch event is now taking place one day earlier, on October 29, at the same venue as originally planned. The company says it will cover the costs of…
